title: Chapter 74 Qin Yi Recovers And Joins The Wasteland City
content:
Chapter 74 Qin Yi Recovers And Joins The Wasteland City

At the same time, all the creatures in the entire Human Emperor Hall were teleported out in an instant.

Some creatures who were about to get the opportunity were even more angry and scolded.

Inside the Human Emperor Hall, Qin Yi looked at the dilapidated Human Emperor Hall at this time. After a long silence, he slowly smiled.

"My human imperial palace will surely prosper."

"You're doing a good job."

As soon as he finished speaking, a sudden sound suddenly sounded from the side.

Suddenly, Qin Yi's face changed drastically. He suddenly turned around and looked, and saw that a human man appeared on the side at some point.

Can he suddenly appear without him noticing that, is there such a strong man in the world of all spirits? !

"Who is your Excellency?"

Qin Yi looked at the person in front of him with fear and spoke.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng was looking at him with a smile.

"As I, I am the father of the successor of the Human Emperor Palace you just designated."

Upon hearing this, Qin Yi was shocked.

The girl’s father just now?

Unexpectedly, the other party's father was so terrifying. Although his current strength was very different from his heyday, he still had eyesight.

At this time, Lu Daosheng could not see through it in his eyes.

At this moment, Qin Yi suddenly thought of something and then asked, "Where did your Xuanyuan Sword come from?"

Hearing this question, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Don't worry about this."

He can't say that he was free in the system store.

Then Lu Daosheng continued, "My daughter is in the realm, how dare you plot against her like this?"

Speaking of this, Qin Yi suddenly felt a strong sense of crisis.

Great horror!

Qin Yi's face looked a little ugly, but he still said, "It's too late to say this now. Your daughter has taken over this cause and effect. No matter what, she has to bear it."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng immediately sneered: "You fought for the human race back then, I respect you, but now you plotted against my daughter, you won't let it go. Do you really think I dare not deal with you?"

Hearing this, Qin Yi lowered his head. After a long time, he slowly said, "If you do it, then come on. Anyway, I have died once."

Qin Yi is just a remnant soul now, and there is a high probability that he will have no future.

Unless you take over the body.

But a strong man like him would not want to survive in that way.

Seeing Qin Yi as rogue, Lu Daosheng was speechless.

Qin Yi was really a little careful about inheriting the inheritance of the Human Emperor Palace, and the cause and effect were not small, but these were not important, because no matter how big the cause and effect was, he would not let Lu Xue bear it alone.

The purpose of Lu Dao’s visit here was mainly for Qin Yi.

But now it seems that Qin Yi is a little incomprehensible.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng stopped keeping himself and said directly: "Do you want to follow me?"

Hearing this, Qin Yi was stunned.

Seeing Lu Daosheng's eyes seem to be joking, Qin Yi shook his head and said, "I am the Lord of the Human Emperor Palace after all. Even if I am not ashamed of it now, I will not choose to stay under others. Qin Yi appreciates your kindness."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng sighed, then took out a golden pill and said while playing with it: "Is that so, that's a pity. I originally planned to help you recast your body, restore your soul, and help you get more up. It's a floor."

After saying that, Lu Daosheng sighed heavily again, then turned around and left.

But the pace is very slow.

And just as Lu Daosheng was about to leave, a voice sounded behind him.

"slow!"

"What you said just now, but it's true?"

Qin Yi said in a trembling voice.

He was a little excited at this time, although he had already been ready to leave since the remnant soul energy was exhausted.

But if you can live, who doesn’t want to live?

Hearing Qin Yi's words, Lu Daosheng turned around and chuckled, "What I said is indeed true, but you don't want to stay under others?"

Hearing this, Qin Yi looked a little embarrassed, but then he said seriously: "The difference between these words of seniors. The original intention of the establishment of the Human Emperor Palace is to follow the real Human Emperor. As the former master of the Human Emperor Palace, your daughter is Now the successor of the Human Emperor Palace is still wearing the Xuanyuan Sword. I follow you, which is the general trend."

Hearing these words, Lu Daosheng smiled and then threw the golden pill to Qin Yi.

I saw that there were nine traces on it.

Looking at the pill in his hand, Qin Yi breathed rapidly and did not hesitate and swallowed it directly.

入口即化。

Suddenly, a magnificent vitality continued to emerge, and Qin Yi's residual soul became solidified to the naked eye.

However, it was not over yet. Lu Daosheng took out another exquisite little bottle and then dripped a drop of spiritual liquid at Qin Yi.

I saw that the crystal liquid was absorbed immediately after it touched Qin Yi's soul.

The next moment, Qin Yi's soul suddenly shone brightly, and the colorful rays of light continued to burst out from the soul.

At the same time, Qin Yi's soul volatility occurred.

见到这一幕，秦逸顿时激动无比。

真的有效，居然是真的。

这到底是什么宝物啊。

On the side, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, "It's not over yet?"

Hearing this, Qin Yi was stunned for a moment, and then his face changed slightly. He felt a strange force in his soul being constantly transformed.

At this time, Qin Yi's soul was already as solid as the essence.

At this moment, Qin Yi's soul changed again. Flesh and blood began to grow based on Qin Yi's soul.

Flesh, it's a flesh!

The growth speed of these flesh and blood was extremely fast. In just a few minutes, a complete flesh appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

Feeling the recovery of the flesh, Qin Yi was excited.

This flesh was even better than his original flesh.

Qin Yi looked at Lu Daosheng and was about to speak.

With a bang.

A strong breath suddenly came from the body.

And the breath was still growing!

The peak of the Potian Realm, the early stage of the Linshen Realm, the middle stage of the Linshen Realm, and it was not until the Divine Realm that the breath stopped.

At this time, Qin Yi was already stupidly stunned in the same place.

This is the Divine Realm?

On the side, Lu Daosheng was also a little surprised, but after a closer look, he also understood it.

Qin Yi has been at the peak of the Potian Realm for a long time, and his foundation is extremely deep.

Coupled with the Creation Spirit Liquid he gave, it was natural for him to break through to the God Realm.

"I, Qin Yi, swear here that I am willing to follow you in this life!"

At this time, Qin Yi suddenly knelt down on one knee towards Lu Daosheng.

Lu Daosheng not only gave Qin Yi a future, but also an extremely bright future.

Moreover, even now that Qin Yi has reached the God Realm, he has not seen through Lu Daosheng at all.

In his opinion, Lu Daosheng may be a true supreme existence.

It is not wronged at all to follow such a person.

Hearing Qin Yi's words, Lu Daosheng also nodded with satisfaction.

"Qin Yi, the Lord of the Heavenly Court and the Holy Gate should be the same as you, right?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng smiled.

Hearing this, Qin Yi immediately reacted, "You want to?"

Lu Daosheng nodded.

Qin Yi was silent for a moment, and then nodded.

He followed the existence in front of him, so the two of them naturally couldn't fall behind.

In this way, the two left the Human Emperor Palace and headed towards the direction of the Heavenly Palace ruins.

At this time, the Lord of Heaven and the Lord of the Holy Gate looked at the direction of the Human Emperor Palace, and they were already shocked.

Because they felt Qin Yi's breath, and it was extremely strong, without any trace of injury.

"Qin Yi, you really deserve to die! It turns out that we were all lying when we agreed to die together."

"Qin, I will never forgive you even if I become a ghost!"
